reviews.title: This company is a scam. Stay away!
reviews.text: This company is a scam. This airline canceled my flight for August 3rd the night before we were supposed to fly out with NO NOTIFICATION… no email, no text. If we didn’t try checking in the night before there would have been no way of knowing. Instead we had to pay $800 each with a different airline last minute to fly between Johannesburg to Cape Town in SA. The customer service is absolutely terrible. When we called for a refund they said over the phone, no problem, just send us an email and we will work on your refund. I’ve been emailing the customer service representative, Chantel, for the last two hours who will only give me credit. This is illegal and unacceptable. I will be contacting my bank and the local department of transportation. I will not allow this company to steal money and just throw credit for an airline that’s not in service.
reviews.author: AFarraj2

reviews.title: FlyMango has stolen my money
reviews.text: They have cancelled flights to Zanzibar and are refusing to refund my cash i paid but give me vouchers im not even able to use or book alternate flights their service is pathetic its absurd that they dont wanna give me my money
reviews.author: Jean C

reviews.title: Incompetent/Useless
reviews.text: Don't fly I repeat don't fly with this unapologetic, coward management company who hide in their offices instead of telling you the truth so you can try salvage your holiday
reviews.author: Dylan

reviews.title: Mango Customer service really sucks
reviews.text: I have tried for 3 days in a row to try and change the date on three flights. Website change booking function doesn't work, and I have waited for 30 mins for a customer service agent to pick up the call. When they did, the line was bad so they hung up! They don't ask for your number so they can return the call, all lines are always busy, no matter which number you dial. Hire more agents Mango! Won't ever use this airline again.
reviews.author: Itta Roussos

reviews.title: Shocking service
reviews.text: Can not change, alter or get a refund for flights due in June 21. We can't travel due to the corrupt sa government's dealing of the covid crisis. Will spend my tourist £$ elsewhere.
reviews.author: Garytreez

reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text: WORST AIRLINE SERVICE EVER! honestly I am going to write a review everywhere so that I can to help people save money because I never ever want anyone to go through the horrible missions we have had to go through. DO NOT EVER USE MANGO
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.title: DO NOT USE MANGO! rather pay the extra R100 and get proper service from FlySafair.
reviews.text: I purposefully booked an early Monday morning flight so I could make it back from my meetings. Sunday evening we get an SMS to say our flight has been pushed to 2:30pm Monday afternoon without warning or compensation. After trying to call them and resolve the issue all I got was "I understand sir but Mango won't compensate you as it's not our problem." They wouldn't even compensate the difference between flight charges from the more expensive morning flight to the cheaper afternoon flight, and made it seem like they were doing me a favour. Incompetent airline, run by incompetent people = Shocking service delivery. Why not push the later flight to early morning? why not transfer us to a different airline? why not reimburse the fare as an apology for your error because if I miss a flight you fine me around 75% of the airfare.
reviews.author: Ross

reviews.title: Never on time
reviews.text: I have flown mango only about 5 times. It's never my first choice, and everytime I end up flying with them they are not on time. This flight is no different JE162 is delayed by an hour. How does that even happen. And in the last 6 years everytime I flew with Mango or someone I knew flew with them they were late
reviews.author: Felicia S

reviews.title: Conference Tour Bookings
reviews.text: Malcom Auto Mechanics Bookings at the meeting of all Southern Mechanics appreciated the flight services on board.
reviews.author: Dumangamandla Tours

reviews.title: Feeling cheated
reviews.text: Two things to be aware of: Flight 1 - Cape Town to Bloemfontein: They will cancel your flight at short notice and you’ll never hear from them again. Regardless of the effort you make - including calling their premium rate customer service number - you won’t be able to rebook or get a voucher or refund. They will not respond to your emails either. I’ve been trying both portals since October 2020. To no avail. Flight 2 - Johannesburg to Cape Town: If you have a fully flexible ticket offering unlimited changes, you may think you’re OK to take advantage of that. Not a chance. Any change you try and make will add almost double the cost of the original flight you had (calling it a fare difference). Interestingly, when you go on line to buy a new ticket for the exact same flight you want to change to, it will cost exactly the same as your original booking. Why then is there a premium on the fare if I want to change it. My advice - Don’t book anything with this airline. Nothing. If this is how they treat their paying customers, you have to wonder how they treat their staff and maintain aircraft?
reviews.author: Bossies

reviews.title: NO CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: Poor service! I have been trying for a week to get through to customer service via the phone. Ran out of airtime holding on every time. After getting somebody that answered the phone, I was told she cannot help me to change my flight as I need to do that 2 hours before the flight. Ha - Ha!!! How? If it took a week to answer the phone??? Poor service!
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: So its a 3.5 hour flight departing at 07h00 - no problem. Hmm, actually big problem. No food outlets open at the airport at that hour with check In 2 hours before flight - so, do Mango do anything about it? Like have food on board? that would be a big NOOO. No food on the flight back and nothing available at Zanzibar airport. Such terrible, terrible service - AVOID!!!!
reviews.author: Brendan

reviews.title: Worst experience of my life
reviews.text: Our flight got cancelled without Any prior notice, which causes us to miss our connecting flight to Germany.I would not rely on Mango Airlines ever again.
reviews.author: dieter

reviews.title: Worst Experience!
reviews.text: Be careful, they are not informing you when they cancel a Flight! Worst experience ever. No customer support!!!
reviews.author: kbereczky

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Calls are never answered Emails are never responded to You end up paying more for a flight instead of getting a voucher or canceling
reviews.author: faatimahm2016

reviews.title: Compliments
reviews.text: I would like to thank Mango airlines for their great service and effeciency, I wish I had the name of the flight attended who ensured that all regulations were followed as she definitely took pride in her work! Well done!!
reviews.author: Ruben Landsberg

reviews.title: Appalling service.
reviews.text: AVOID USING THIS AIRLINE! Had absolutely appalling service - refusal to assist with any queries. Worst airline I’ve EVER dealt with. I’m disgusted.
reviews.author: Dee

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: There must be about 3 people in the call center, and I'm 95% sure they are children. Appalling service and a flat out refusal to escalate any queries that are above them. Mango Airlines is owned by SAA, so it's common knowledge that they are in financial turmoil. If you purchase a ticket through Mango, there is no guarantee that they will be around for your flight date. They will, however, gladly take your money.
reviews.author: Andrew Ehmke

reviews.title: incompetent
reviews.text: we flew very well to Durban coming back,we experienced delays instead every 45min we supposed to change entrances our flight delayed with 5hrs it was carrying 5 monts old baby it was bad experience ever
reviews.author: mpumi

reviews.title: Mango review
reviews.text: In July 2020 my family and I flew down to Durban from Johannesburg as my dad had passed away. We were greeted by absolutely rude staff who told us we missed our flight and do we see anyone else in the que and I having lost my dad that day burst into tears and only then was I told they were joking. Fast forward to August I book and pay for flights down to Cape Town in October 2020 and I receive no confirmation of my flights even tho the money has been taken off my account. I phone Mango thet advise me that they see the booking but no payment and that I should provide proof if payment which I do, the lady then makes another booking and tells me to pay again which I refuse as I have paid for my flights originally booked and Mango does not give refunds only vouchers. I have had to phone them numerous times to follow up and the last phone call I made to them the woman asked for a reference to which I told her I only have the reference of the second booking the other lady made which is not paid for so she told me to give it to her. We went back and fourth and eventually she told me that I didn't understand, the refunds department is not there and the flight has not been paid for. To date Mango has not gotten back to me about my paid flights. I would highly not recommend them if this is the way they treat passengers!
reviews.author: Cherise

reviews.title: Was very smooth flight.
reviews.text: The flight was good, the seating was a little cramped but it was not too bad. It was still a very good flight and was very clean.
reviews.author: Greg Cook

reviews.title: Ms Sarah Nyakunengwa
reviews.text: Booked the mango flex tickets which seemed like a great option at the time since it offers unlimited date changes a 70 rand on board meal and extra 10kgs luggage each. Both tickets were of the same price as i was travelling with my child who pays full price and gets a sit of her own,however at check in i was made to pay for excess luggage off R880.00 which was meantto be included in the ticket price. They said my child was an infant and would not qualify for the same,yet infant don't pay for a full ticket price like I had. This information is not stipulated and not clear enough on their site. Also when booking it will tell you they accept a drivers license only after payment it states it has to be a South African one do make sure you have your passport.The flight was delayed for 35 minutes due to Admin issues and never got the R70.00 on board meal as mentioned on this flexi upgrade option.Personally i feel that this is false marketing and a rip off.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.title: MANGO AIRLINE MAR 2020
reviews.text: Low cost airline service, check-in was easy, boarding was terrible - not organised, flight was great - on time departure, Seating is the worst on any airline that I have experienced - sardines in a tin-can.
reviews.author: Muhsin M

reviews.title: On time
reviews.text: Left and arrived on time. Very energetic and friendly cabin crew considering the flight was a 5:55 am flight.
reviews.author: Ilhaam38

reviews.title: Inability to pay for changed flight on line
reviews.text: Mango is a great airline. Three little problems however. 1) I initially paid for a flexible ticket yet when I changed it I still had to pay in extra? 2) We were kept waiting for a long time in the tunnel leading into the aircraft. The aircraft was obviously not ready for us to board - why did they not rather leave us in the airport building until the aircraft was ready instead of standing in the tunnel? 3) It was impossible to to pay for my changed flight on line. Had to physically pay at the airport notwithstanding that I could change the flight on line ...but not pay? BRILLIANT service and efficiency and smiles of staff.
reviews.author: Adventurer42646

reviews.title: Friendly Efficient
reviews.text: The staff were incredibly efficient, polite, helpful, respectful even the Pilot had a fantastic sense of humour
reviews.author: Sean Kirkbride

reviews.title: Flight
reviews.text: Excellent service from Mango staff service efficient and always walking around with smiles. Thank you
reviews.author: Antionette and Sydney Loubser

reviews.title: A very Pleasant Experience
reviews.text: My wife and I have traveled on long distance flights in economy and the leg room was non existent, but on this local Mango flight the leg room was phenomenal to the extent that we could stretch our legs out comfortably and there was so much room for our knees! in addition, as there is no business class, we were able to book our seats right up front which enabled us to get on and off the plane quickly.
reviews.author: Kessie Moodley

reviews.title: Worst Airline experience imagineable AVOID!!
reviews.text: My experience flying Mango Airlines (which is part of the almost bankrupt SAA) might sound like a movie, because its almost unbelievable. This happened yesterday. I checked in at 10:30 AM for a supposed 12 15 flight. I went to the boarding gate at 11:40. When 12:15 came and went we were casually told there was a "delay". Its happened to me before on Mango but who could have known what was coming. After about 2 more hours of staff telling us theres a delay...we saw them continuously looking outside..as their was NO Mango plane. Eventually a white jet appeared with no Mango markings. They simply had no plane. They changed the gate number 3!! Times. On the 3rd try the staff said " no this gate is going to Cape Town!" What??? The staff had no idea where the plane was even taking off or which plane it would be! It gets worse..on landing eventually in Joannesburg we could not disembark because the captain said "There is NO driver to bring the right steps over for this type of plane" Theres more, if you can believe it. After 20 minutes locked in the plane we got off. At the baggage section nothing happened..no luggage moving. A Mango rep makes an announcement that they have to remove the bags MANUALLY! 45 minutes later we got our bags. I told the Mango rep that they should stop selling tickets as they are supplying NO service at all. It took 6! Hours to get from Durban to Jhb!! Its a 1 hour flight. I told them to shut down the airline it would be a great public service. This morning the news said SAA is going bankrupt. Do not fly SAA or Mango. They dont have the money to maintain the airline and most probably the planes. They both need to close asap before someone really gets hurt. Its gone too far already. Dont be fooled by their cheap prices. You've been warned.
reviews.author: madelinelevy

reviews.title: Low cost flight
reviews.text: Low cost flight for a full airplane, departed and landed on time with a good landing in both Johannesburg & Cape Town. On board service acceptable but costly.
reviews.author: vwk

reviews.title: No choice ,Mango the only airline servicing Zanzibar.
reviews.text: Short delay in boarding,however arrived timeously. The return flight arrived 45 minutes late, leaving passengers in a building without Aircon at 34 degrees, no reasonable hygienic food choices, however the refrigerated beverages were ice cold. The sandwich paid for on the plane was prepared that morning and refrigerated.
reviews.author: Al Pal

reviews.title: efficient and on time
reviews.text: We flew from Port Elizabeth to Johanessburg, return , we were expecting the usual economy type flight. The leg room was suprisingly good, fast and efficient service crew helpful. Food and drinks were available to purchase if required. Flights both ways were on time leaving, and arrived at the destination slightly early. Only concern was that the seats offered little back support to the centre of the back, resulting in some discomfort by the end of the relatively short journey
reviews.author: Traveller1420

reviews.title: Go Mango!
reviews.text: This is the first time we have flown from Bloemfontein to Cape Town, we usually fly from OR Tambo but as Bloemfontein is closer for us we gave it a try. We had a slight delay on departure (weather related) but we were updated on a regular basis. More than enough leg-room and very pleasant staff and crew. Will definitely use this service again.
reviews.author: Joyce S

reviews.title: Mango consistently late
reviews.text: I have been avoiding mango for some time now, but decided to fly them after they had some decent specials. My avoidance was well in order as just as I expected my flight was an hour and a half late... this is totally unacceptable and it seems they don’t mind
reviews.author: Kyle B

reviews.title: Worst airline in the world
reviews.text: In the 50+ countries I have visited, Mango is by far the worst airline I have ever flown. Check-in staff was rude, lazy and unhelpful. The flight was delayed well over an hour. Gate staff didn’t communicate at all on the status. I go to the website to check estimated departure, no updates either. In-flight crew where good. SOuth African Air kept cancelling flights and they booked me on this airline. Strongly recommend avoiding at all costs.
reviews.author: Josh D

reviews.title: Complete rip off
reviews.text: if there was a negative rating I would give it........I tried to make a reservation via mangos website,it gave me an error code stating that the flight was in loading and I was unable to book for it. I went to an agent and booked a ticket thinking it was just a system error however when I checked my messages I saw that a charge had gone off for the mango flight I had tried to book online... I called them to find out what had happened and how I could go about getting the amount refunded I was informed it was a system error and the money would automatically be returned to my account with in 48h as I had not received an email to confirm the tickets.... it has now been 3days I still have not received my money back and every time I try call them the line cuts out.....worst airline ever completely unethical and pathetic I will be raising a claim with my bank in this regard and never use them again!!!
reviews.author: tracygoddard60

reviews.title: A very poor and basic flight experience!
reviews.text: We were delayed for over 2. hrs. No reason for this delay was given and when we eventually boarded the plane, no apology or complimentary drinks were provided!!! The customer service was terrible and I would not recommend anyone using this airline! The company need to review all of their customer service procedures.
reviews.author: aldeburgh12345

reviews.title: FLIGHT WITH MANGO
reviews.text: The staff were very helpful and friendly. It was a flight were you felt safe. It was my first flight after 20 years and it was very nice
reviews.author: Petro

reviews.title: Always late.
reviews.text: I dread afternoon flights from Cape Town. There is always something and they never communicate. At one point I arrive home at 0200
reviews.author: Sbuda

reviews.title: Training in Kempton Park
reviews.text: Flight was early. Had to pay for extra luggage as I was 5kg over limit. Ground crew very helpful to assist with all information. Luggage weren't damaged at all. Mango is cashless and only use cards. May ask for a receipt.
reviews.author: DeonV165

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: This has to be the worst flight I have ever had. Still sitting on the plane. Take off was meant to be 14:00 it’s now 15:20. Shocking I will never fly with mango again. I recommend a different airline to anyone wanting to travel local. They take your money very fast and offer this shocking service. They don’t even offer water to the guests
reviews.author: Basil

reviews.title: Great value for money!
reviews.text: Travelling quite a bit in South Africa, I am always very grateful when I can find a good deal on flight-tickets. The staff and service as a whole are professional. I wish they could have competitive pricing more often than they do!
reviews.author: Khosi

reviews.title: Very Very Poor!!
reviews.text: We flew with Mango from Jhb to PE on the 8th of Feb, took a tour down to CT and then flew back from CT to Jhb on the 16th of Feb again with Mango. For starters both flights were delayed; apparently it is a standard feature for Mango. Arriving at PE airport our suitcases were wet and dirty. The one in particular were so wet that we had to stop at the drycleaners for an hour to get the clothes dry and to avoid a smell in the suitcase. On our flight back we flew with a friend who had a 2month old baby. A month before the flight we asked if she could sit on the front seat where there is more space just to make it easier, but were told that those seats are kept for people with wheelchairs ( al 6 of them), but when we got on the plane they were giving to normal young people... After waiting an hour for the delayed flight, I got on the plane, asked for a coke and it was warm. So I asked for ice and they had no ice. So if Mango does not improve their service they will not see us again.
reviews.author: Jaco Botha

reviews.title: Impressed
reviews.text: Impressed with our flight to Durban. Like all these airlines, you need to purchase onboard refreshments. The staff were very helpful, From the check-in counter, to the cabin crew. Great flight, and I enjoyed the scenery on a clear day
reviews.author: Chris P

reviews.title: Comfortable seats with lots of legroom
reviews.text: We flew to Capetown for the Federer/Nadal/Noah/Gates Charity Tennis match The Durban to Capetown flight departed spot on time, but the return flight back to Durban was delayed (not necessarily the fault of the airline) I found the cabin staff friendly and polite, and there was plenty of room for cabin baggage . I will happily fly with them again
reviews.author: Hugh1944

reviews.title: Bizarre cabin crew behavior
reviews.text: Having flown this airline many times, I am gobsmacked at the level of service onboard the flight today. It is bad enough that the flight was delayed by an hour but the staff on board need some basic training in customer service. My suitcase which has fitted on every Mango flight ever taken today was “too big.” No it’s not, yes it is! I don’t have the energy and so it gets taken off the plane only to be replaced by a bag of exactly the same size. Priceless! No I have no more desire to use your airline! Wow pathetic rude staff.
reviews.author: Jasonleg

reviews.title: Very good flight
reviews.text: When I fly locally it must be with Mango Airlines. They the best in South Africa. I have never experienced delays with them. Their seats are spacious and plenty of legroom. They better than most international flights.
reviews.author: Beatty Davids

reviews.title: Punctual? Not this time
reviews.text: Mango is not my airline of choice and my return flights from Jhb to Cape Town did nothing to change my point of view. Both flights departed late (between 10 & 20 minutes) and at least one arrived more than 10 minutes late. For the first there was an excuse, with rather heavy rains on the tarmac. Also some very strange arrangements with our departure. We were called for boarding and then left standing in a queue after the boarding gate for almost 15 minutes. The ones sitting at the back of the plane were the given preferential boarding while we had to wait till they were all seated. Nonsensical if you ask me. All other airlines allow simultaneous boarding.
reviews.author: 693brahmd

reviews.title: Very Pleasant
reviews.text: We booked return flights to Cape Town on the 18th January 2020 with Mango Airlines, everything was great. There were no delays. Checkin was fast and efficient. No complaints, not the first time we used them and hopefully it won't be the last.
reviews.author: Yellowribbon2014

reviews.title: Return home
reviews.text: My flight home went off smoothly with no glitches. The check-in process was quick and the flight was comfortable.
reviews.author: Wayne M
